issues.title: marshal-pi: the drain after a live push acks other unread messages without showing them
Direct messages come back unread after the recipient session is DEL'd and re-registered (pi /reload or restart re-injects them 20 at a time)
marshal-pi: live push ignores `body_truncated`, so a truncated message looks complete
